# AIERXUAN

> AIERXUAN is a Shenzhen-based OEM/ODM manufacturer of laptops and Mini PCs for B2B buyers, distributors, system integrators, and corporate procurement. Founded in 2014, the company offers fully customized hardware — your configuration, your branding, your certifications — from sample to bulk production.

## Company facts

- Company: AIERXUAN (爱尔选)
- Business model: OEM / ODM manufacturing (B2B wholesale & customization, not retail)
- Products: Custom laptops, gaming notebooks, and Mini PCs
- Founded: 2014 (10+ years manufacturing experience)
- Intel Partner since: 2019
- Units shipped: 500,000+ to 500+ clients across 50+ countries
- Facility: 15,000㎡ in Longgang District, Shenzhen, China
- Production lines: 6 | Monthly capacity: 50,000+ units | Team: 200+
- Product certifications: CE, FCC, RoHS
- Facility certifications: ISO 9001, ISO 14001
- MOQ: from 100 units (samples available from 1–10 units)
- Lead times: samples 7–15 days; standard production 15–25 days; large orders 25–45 days; rush 3–5 days (subject to component availability)
- Incoterms: EXW, FOB, CIF, DDP
- First response: within 24 hours

## What AIERXUAN customizes

CPU, RAM, storage, ports, chassis, BIOS, boot logo, and packaging — fully white-label hardware under the buyer's own brand. Region-specific certification support including EAC (Russia/EAEU).
